sections.name: Persona question tiles

8 use-case tiles as primary nav into solution pages

sections.name: Tabbed use cases

Each tab shows 4 sequential product states, teaching the workflow visually
Each industry tab is a mini landing page: hero image + 3 solution links
Build/Manage/Optimize crossed with 4 personas: matrix compression of a huge feature set
Tab carousel as progressive disclosure instead of a long scroll
